subject.title: transcripts: show prints stored terminal escapes from imported text

question: Should transcript summary Markdown strip terminal controls at render/store time, CLI display time, or both?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the permanent contract differs depending on whether stored `summary.md` itself is guaranteed terminal-safe or only the CLI display path is sanitized.

options.title: Sanitize Markdown at render/store time
options.body: Persist terminal-safe `summary.md` so every human-readable viewer and CLI path is protected while raw JSON can remain the fidelity-preserving artifact.

options.title: Sanitize only on CLI display
options.body: Keep stored Markdown faithful to imported text but make `openclaw transcripts show` terminal-safe, leaving other viewers responsible for escaping.

recommendation.title: Sanitize Markdown at render/store time
recommendation.body: Persist terminal-safe `summary.md` so every human-readable viewer and CLI path is protected while raw JSON can remain the fidelity-preserving artifact.

likelyOwner.reason: The transcript summary/store/CLI path is tied to his current-main and merged-feature history, making him the strongest routing candidate for this boundary decision.
